title.en: Read the reference registry: five pointers, nothing third-party

goal.en: A registry lists what exists and where; it does not host it. The reference registry at cookwala.ai points at the catalog, the example recipes, the default limits, the WHO/Codex rule pack and the agent-safety benchmark, all from this repository.

note.en: Five entries, each with a kind, a name under ai.cookwala/, a verification method and a repository pointer.
The recipe collection the registry points at is the nine the hub serves.
The registry says it in its own note: pointers only, nothing here is a third-party product.

expect.registry.note: Pointers only. Everything listed exists in the amado2k5/cookwala repository; nothing here is a third-party product. Anyone may run a registry (RFC-0002, RFC-0006).

outcome.en: You know what a registry entry looks like and that anyone may run one. Scenarios 090 onwards cover publishing, verification and federation.
